verdict.rationale: Phaser ships an official Game Agent MCP server that lets users 'describe what you want in plain language and your agent calls the tools for you,' integrating with Claude Desktop, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, etc., and the phaser.io/agent page shows a natural-language prompt interface ('What game do you want me to make?'). This directly supports natural-language operation of the product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the agent's real-world reliability and depth beyond first-party marketing docs.
